WITH cust AS (
  SELECT "customer_id", COUNT(DISTINCT "order_id") AS cnt
  FROM "ecommerce_orders_f06afcec"."data"
  GROUP BY "customer_id"

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cnt >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_customers,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cnt = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_customers,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cnt >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repurchase_rate_pct
FROM cust

  SELECT "customer_id", COUNT(DISTINCT "order_id") AS cnt
  FROM "ecommerce_orders_f06afcec"."data"
  GROUP BY "customer_id"
)
SELECT cnt AS order_count, COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM cust
GROUP BY cnt
ORDER BY cnt

WITH cust AS (
  SELECT "customer_id", "region", COUNT(DISTINCT "order_id") AS cnt
  FROM "ecommerce_orders_f06afcec"."data"
  GROUP BY "customer_id", "region"
)
SELECT "region",
       COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cnt >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_customers,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cnt >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repurchase_rate
FROM cust
GROUP BY "region"
ORDER BY repurchase_rate DESC
